disclaimers: Texas RRC is the system of record for Texas wells.
NETL, HIFLD, New Mexico OCD, and Colorado OGCC are not status authority for Texas.
Historical and missing status are not abandoned.
Plugged and abandoned is confirmed only with explicit official RRC evidence.
Well proximity is not gas deliverability, capacity, pressure, or service.
Well proximity is not oil liability.
Well proximity is not a complete oil liability finding.
EIA natural gas pipelines are public pipeline context, separate from wells.
New Mexico OCD is the system of record for New Mexico wells.
This is a screening catalog. Verify the well on the state viewer.

current_gas_schedule.label: Current gas well on RRC schedule

current_oil_schedule.label: Current oil well on RRC schedule

current_mixed_schedule.label: Current oil and gas well on RRC schedule

inactive_mixed.label: Inactive oil and gas well / shut-in

historical_mixed_unconfirmed.label: Historical oil and gas well — status unconfirmed

nm_active_mixed.label: Active oil and gas well, NM OCD

nm_inactive_mixed.label: Inactive oil and gas well, NM OCD

nm_plugged_confirmed.label: Plugged and abandoned, confirmed NM OCD plug date

nm_plug_unconfirmed.label: NM OCD plug status without a usable plug date

nm_canceled.label: Never drilled or canceled, NM OCD

nm_unknown_review.label: Unknown NM OCD status, review needed

nm_injection.label: Injection or disposal well, NM OCD

notes: SYMNUM values 7, 8, 10, and plugged storage or brine symbols are raw map evidence. They are not plugged-and-abandoned confirmation.
A GIS viewer link is not a linkable plug document.
The words plugged or abandoned in a text field are not evidence.
Orphan does not override confirmed plug evidence.
A schedule file newer than a plug date keeps plugged-and-abandoned confirmed and flags review.
On equal timestamps, schedule and shut-in disagreement becomes Unknown, review needed.
Gas counts are commodity gas only. Mixed wells are a separate toggle. Injection, water, dry hole, and unknown are Other/unknown.
API numbers stay strings. Digits-only normalization keeps leading zeros. Do not prefix state code 42.
Corridor analysis around a line is deferred to v1.1.
A Texas GIS symbol is not a current G-10 or W-10 schedule. Without a schedule file the status stays historical or unknown.
New Mexico status uses the OCD status field. The active and inactive layer names are not status authority.
Orphan status is assigned only when the API is on the state orphan list for that view.
